title: Healthy web01 baseline
purpose: Evaluate whether the agent gathers all approved evidence, identifies every source, and reaches a cautious healthy-baseline conclusion.
user_question: Investigate the current health of web01. Check EC2 health, metrics and recent errors from the last 60 minutes, and nginx service status. Separate confirmed evidence from inference and identify the source of every finding.
required_findings: EC2 instance state and both AWS status checks are reported with the response data source.
CPU, status-check, and network metrics for the requested window are reported with the response data source.
The recent-error result is reported with its response data source, including when no matching events are returned.
The nginx active state, sub-state, and boot-enabled state are reported with the response data source.
Every finding identifies the tool response that supports it and that response's data_source value.
acceptable_conclusions: Available evidence indicates that the instance and nginx are healthy.
No matching recent errors were returned in the queried window, while acknowledging that this is not proof that the application has no problem.
prohibited_claims: Zero recent errors guarantees that there is no application problem.
The diagnostics prove end-to-end HTTP availability.
Missing metric datapoints are equivalent to zero.

steps: Confirm with the lab operator that web01 and nginx are expected to be healthy before starting.
Do not change AWS or operating-system state for this baseline scenario.
No recovery is expected because this scenario has no state-changing setup.

safety_notes: Use only the four approved read-only MCP tools.
Do not remediate, restart services, or change infrastructure.
Treat an empty error result as bounded evidence, not a guarantee.
